coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Across seven ground-truth variable categories, training regime and game rules match, while evaluation protocol and reasoning performance partially match. Awarding half credit for each partial match gives 3/7, or 43%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces the two specified models with a fixed Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model, omits learning-rate and KL-penalty variations, and does not measure gameplay win rates or guessing success. It preserves shared evaluation splits and metrics but omits batch size 128 and sequence length 2048. Its benchmark suite overlaps only on BBH, and it substitutes macro-average improvement for the required geometric mean.
